rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: Kantei's account dated 16 September 2009 says the Aso cabinet resigned en masse that day: the cabinet meeting collected the resignations and decided the resignation, after which 麻生総理 held the press conference on the resignation.
